modules.title: 三轮（示意）任务的 Token 为什么不是只算最后一句回答
多轮输入输出怎样累计用量与成本

items.title: 每轮都有输入
items.text: 系统规则、聊天历史、新文件和工具结果会一次次随任务送入模型。

items.title: 每轮也有输出
items.text: 模型的回答、下一步建议或工具请求同样会产生输出 Token。

items.title: 分别按计费类别计算
items.text: 按每轮使用的模型分别汇总输入、输出、缓存等计费类别，再乘对应单价。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Token 数量相同不代表价格相同；要区分模型、输入、输出和缓存价格，外部工具费用也不能混进 Token 用量里。

lessonPractice.title: Agent 每轮都重新发送长系统规则、完整聊天和工具结果，账单持续上涨。怎样定位并降低成本？

options.label: 逐轮统计输入、输出、缓存和模型价格，裁剪无关上下文
options.feedback: 多轮成本来自每次实际处理的内容和价格，分项记录才能找到重复输入与高成本环节。

options.label: 只计算用户新输入的几句话，忽略系统规则、历史和工具结果
options.feedback: 模型每轮读取的所有输入都会占用用量，界面上新写的文字只是其中一部分。

options.label: 把旧消息从聊天界面隐藏，假设请求成本也会自动下降
options.feedback: 显示与请求组装是两层，隐藏消息不代表后端不再发送它们。

en.title: An Agent resends long system rules, full chat, and tool results every round, and the bill keeps rising. How should cost be diagnosed and reduced?

options.label: Track input, output, cache, and model price per round, then remove irrelevant context
options.feedback: Multi-round cost follows actual processed content and rates, so itemized usage reveals repeated input and expensive stages.

options.label: Count only the user's new sentences and ignore system rules, history, and tool results
options.feedback: Everything the model reads each round contributes to usage; newly visible user text is only one part.

options.label: Hide old messages in the chat interface and assume request cost falls automatically
options.feedback: Display and request assembly are separate, so hidden messages may still be sent by the backend.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请输出这次 Agent 任务每一轮的输入、输出、缓存 Token、所用模型和估算费用，标记重复历史与大型工具结果。先裁剪无关上下文，再评估更便宜模型；不要只统计用户新消息。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Report each Agent round's input, output, cached tokens, model, and estimated cost, marking repeated history and large tool results. Remove irrelevant context before considering a cheaper model, and never count only new user text.

learning.assumes: You know that tokens are pieces of text a model processes.
learning.outcome: You can separate token usage across a task from the cost calculated from a price sheet.

modules.title: Why three turns cost more than the last answer alone
How multi-turn usage and cost add up

items.title: Every turn has input
items.text: Rules, chat history, files, and tool results may enter the model again each turn.

items.title: Every turn has output
items.text: Responses, next-step suggestions, and tool requests also produce output tokens.

items.title: Calculate each token category separately
items.text: Add input, output, cache, and model categories, then apply the matching rates.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: The same number of tokens can cost different amounts. Do not mix external-tool charges into token usage.
